description.en: Gallimimus bullatus: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1.0m whole living G. bullatus based on 1972 adult type100/11 skull and 2006 Fig2A. Narrow toothless bill, long S-neck, slim running legs and balancing tail; B/C other taxa excluded. Soft tissue, short filament coat, sandy color, pose and modest terminal tail completion are inferred/artistic, not direct preserved feather or color claims.
